name: Worn Boots
description: Your own two feet and whatever you can sling over your shoulders. Slow, undefended, but it costs nothing.

name: Horse
description: Fast and light. Covers ground quickly but there's only so much you can strap to a saddle.

name: Hand Cart
description: Slower than a horse, but it carries far more than your own back ever could.

name: Horse Cart
description: Real cargo volume behind real speed. A wagon proper, capable of coastal roads a cart alone couldn't manage.

name: Covered Wagon
description: A canvas-topped wagon that keeps cargo dry and adds a real hold's worth of capacity.

name: Armored Wagon
description: Iron-plated sides and a reinforced frame. Slower to accelerate, much harder to rob.

name: Land-Ship
description: An engineered marvel of sail, wheel, and ward-iron. The mark of a wayfarer who has truly arrived — and the safest, fastest, roomiest thing on any road.
